requirements.text: Manage and evolve our cloud infrastructure. Keep things running, scale what needs scaling, and build new infrastructure with a bias toward simplicity and maintainability. Stack\-agnostic — we care about engineering judgment over familiarity with any specific toolset.

Design, build, and maintain AI\-driven workflows that automate real business processes — LLM integration, MCP servers, agentic pipelines, and automated ops tooling. You own technical execution end\-to\-end, guided by product direction.

Contribute across the stack when the team needs it — debugging front\-end issues, supporting releases, or picking up work that doesn't fit neatly into a lane. Customer\-facing app experience is a bonus, not the focus.

Proactively communicate with cross\-functional stakeholders who aren't engineers — operations leads, commercial teams, external partners. Explain what you're building, why it matters, and what the tradeoffs are without being asked.
Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. JOLT is unable to provide visa sponsorship for this role at this time.
